extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
extraction.description: A dataset of 246,285 texture images across 56 texture classes generated using text-to-image models from descriptive prompts.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak and Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by generating texture-specific prompts and using them as inputs to Stable Diffusion models, followed by a three-stage refinement process.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images were generated using the Stable Diffusion model from HuggingFace based on constructed text prompts.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A three-stage refinement process was applied consisting of frequency filtering to remove object-like images, patch variance filtering to eliminate homogeneous images, and CLIP score filtering to ensure alignment with prompts.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Images flagged by the Stable Diffusion NSFW filter were excluded from the dataset, even though they did not contain explicit content.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Interpreting high-level features models learn, uncovering biases, identifying security vulnerabilities, and measuring texture bias.

name.evidence: In this work, we introduce an extensible methodology for generating highquality, diverse texture images, which we use to create the Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD), a new texture dataset spanning 246,285 images across 56 texture classes.

description.evidence: These adaptations allow us to create the Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD), a dataset of 246,285 texture images across 56 texture classes.

url.evidence: Our dataset is available for download at https://zenodo.org/records/15359142.

creator.evidence: Blaine Hoaka,*and Patrick McDaniela aUniversity of Wisconsin-Madison

rai:dataCollection.evidence: First, we produce texturespecific prompts to serve as the basis for our texture generation... Second, we use our constructed prompts as inputs to Stable Diffusion model pipelines... Finally, to yield higher-quality and more texture-like images, we perform a three stage refinement process consisting of frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP scoring to filter down the images.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: Second, we use our constructed prompts as inputs to Stable Diffusion model pipelines, which we adapt based on unique challenges we uncover that arise from safety filters sensitivity to texture data, to produce the corresponding texture images.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: Images are generated using the Stable Diffusion model [26] from HuggingFace [32].

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: This process consists of three filtering steps, each targeting different aspects of image quality: (1) frequency filtering to remove object-like images, (2) patch variance filtering to eliminate homogeneous images, and (3) CLIP score filtering to ensure alignment with the prompts.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Although we find no images that actually represent explicit content , for ethical reasons we exclude these flagged images from our final dataset and do not release them publicly.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: Texture data serves as a valuable tool for interpreting the high-level features models leam, uncovering biases, and identifying security vulnerabilities.
